title: humanoid_olympics round input
description: A balanced six-event Humanoid Olympics meet. Every evaluation contains the same number of attempts of each discipline; friction and wind derive deterministically from the private round seed.

seed.description: Fresh master seed for this round's hidden surface and wind conditions.

instances_per_event.description: Attempts of each of the six disciplines. Four yields a 24-attempt meet.

deadline_ms.description: Per-action HTTP deadline for the policy.

wind_max_ms.description: Upper bound for round-derived ground-level wind speed in m/s.

record_history.description: Write one replayable history file per event attempt.

history_stride.description: Keep every Nth 50 Hz control frame in each history file.
